features: modular AutoDome system: interchangeable CPU / camera / housing / comms / mount modules
day/night PTZ camera choice: 18x, 26x, or 36x optical zoom (+12x digital)
36x variant: 3.4-122.4 mm F1.6-4.5, 540 TVL, 128x wide dynamic range
hybrid analog (coax/UTP, Bilinx) + optional Ethernet H.264 IP streaming
advanced privacy masking and sector blanking
EnviroDome housing to -40 C (XT kit to -60 C); IP66 pendant / IK8 in-ceiling
release_notes: The Bosch AutoDome 300 Series is a VG4 modular analog PTZ dome system with interchangeable modules, offered with 18x/26x/36x day/night cameras (1/4-inch Exview HAD CCD, 540 TVL, 128x WDR) and AutoTrack II intelligent tracking. Hybrid analog (coax/UTP, Bilinx) operation with an optional Ethernet module for H.264 IP streaming; no IR illuminator. EnviroDome housing rated to -40 C.
